name: Miki Riichi
source:
Born in Hokkaido, he is Kasane’s childhood friend and best friend. He is the only son of the Miki triplets. He has tremendous love for his younger sisters, and is treated as having a sister complex by others. However, he is very popular among the girls and speaks his mind. His nickname is "Reach."

[From [url=http://gematsu.com/2017/09/memories-off-innocent-fille-launch-ps4-ps-vita-pc#b5Et1Y6rjDrmUh6l.99]Gematsu[/url]]
